meta.description: An Asian founder building software and a coffee shop owner, asking operators why they started and what it actually took. Listen live, put a question to the founder, and find the room of people doing the same work.

hero.eyebrow: A podcast for people behind the counter
hero.title: Every shop has a story before it has a P&L.
hero.body: An Asian founder building software and a coffee shop owner, asking operators why they started and what it actually took — the grind, the pressure, the wins nobody sees. A show for the people doing the work, and the room growing around them.

bands.title: Why did you start?
bands.body: Every episode opens there. Asian American operators — boba, matcha, coffee, and beyond — on the job they left, the lease they signed, and the first year that nearly ended it. The 5am prep, the staffing headaches, the modifier menu that broke the POS: all of it comes up because it's the story, not because we're selling a playbook.

bands.title: Listen live. Ask the founder anything.
bands.body: We record with the room open. Turn up, put your question to the founder while they're still in the chair, and stay for the conversation after. Between episodes it's operators trading notes on suppliers, rent, hiring, and the parts nobody posts about.

people.name: Lulu Cheng
people.role: Builds software for small businesses and consumer apps
people.bio: A decade of engineering behind me — Reddit, Square, Capital One — now spent building the software small businesses actually run on. I ask the questions I wish someone had asked the operators I build for.

bands.title: Every guest leaves with their shop named.
bands.body: We say where it is, link it, and put it in front of a room of people who care where they spend. Come on the show and you get an hour to tell it your way, plus a table of operators who'll pick up when you text them six months later.

bands.title: Know someone with a story?
bands.body: We're always looking for operators to feature — not just the ones with a big exit, but the ones still in it. If that's you, or someone you know, we want to hear it.
